title: Supabase framework code tabs
description: A split section: a two-tone title on the left whose ink word is the chosen framework, and on the right a white code card with a row of six equal icon tabs over a 13px monospace snippet, coloured purple for keywords, amber for strings and green for names, with a small round 'guide' pill under it. Clicking a tab swaps the snippet, the pill and the title's word; icons darken on hover.
notes: needs JavaScript for the tabs (hydrate visible); without it the first framework shows
code comes in as plain text; a tiny built-in highlighter colours it with chart-1 (keywords), chart-2 (names), chart-3 (strings)
long lines scroll sideways inside the card on phones
